thread:
alex_cs: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of accounts in the last import with blank onboarding_stage and duplicate external_id. health_score collapsed for several of them.
maria_ops: ugh, where did the import come from? link?
alex_cs: S3 CSV: s3://prod-imports/2026-03-19/account_batch_0319.csv. Looks like some rows have empty company_name and same external_id.
devon_data: I ran a quick dedupe query:
```
SELECT external_id, COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE created_at > '2026-03-01' GROUP BY external_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
results: ~412 dup keys.
jordan_se: Could be the webhook that retries without idempotency key. We've seen that pattern.
alex_cs: Any risk that playbooks fired multiple times because playbook automation matches onboarding_stage NULL? We had duplicate outreach.
lina_enablement: We got reports from onboarding that customers saw duplicate enablement emails last week.
sam_playbooks_bot: Playbook "welcome_sequence_v2" triggered for 402 accounts at 2026-03-20T14:02Z
maria_ops: Ok plan: 1) pause playbook triggers for newly created accounts 2) run dedupe dry-run 3) backfill onboarding_stage for canonical accounts
devon_data: Dry-run SQL ready, need a small window to run: 
```
-- dry-run
WITH ranked as (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY external_id ORDER BY created_at) rn
  FROM accounts
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1;
```
will output candidates.
alex_cs: timeline? we have renewal risk signals on those accounts — health drop causes AE alerting.
jordan_se: I can add an idempotency check to webhook handler today, quick patch. Will push and schedule a canary.
lina_enablement: For communication: I'll draft a short note to AEs describing what to expect and how we'll mark duplicates in CRM (tag: duplicate_detected).
maria_ops: Also need to ensure health_score recalculation only runs after dedupe. otherwise we flood alerts.
devon_data: I'll add a flag in the backfill job: `skip_health_recalculate = true` then trigger a controlled recalculation after dedupe.
alex_cs: Good. Also capture feedback: customers who got duplicate emails — can we tag them and create a single-thread feedback ticket in Zendesk? we want to measure churn/annoyance.
lina_enablement: I'll coordinate with support. Proposed ticket tag: cs_dup_email_0319
sam_playbooks_bot: Scheduled job: dedupe_dryrun completed. candidates=412. timestamp=2026-03-20T17:45Z
jordan_se: Patch deployed to webhook handler on staging. Will run canary against subset=50.
maria_ops: If canary good, schedule prod deploy at 20:00 UTC. Devon, can you run the dedupe purge and backfill at 21:00 after deploy?
devon_data: Yes, will run purge+backfill 21:00 UTC, will output list of canonical_ids and removed_ids.
alex_cs: After backfill please trigger health recalculation for canonical_ids only.
devon_data: noted. Output will be uploaded to s3://prod-exports/dedupe_results/3770004321-0319.json
lina_enablement: I'll create the Zendesk ticket and add a sample email template for AEs to apologize and offer a help link.
alex_cs: Thank you team. Follow-ups: @jordan_se confirm prod deploy status, @devon_data confirm dedupe output, @lina_enablement confirm ticket id.
maria_ops: :thumbsup:
sam_playbooks_bot: playbook "welcome_sequence_v2" paused for new_accounts in prod
jordan_se: Prod deploy done at 20:03 UTC — webhook idempotency header enforced. Canary ok.
devon_data: Dedupe purge+backfill completed at 21:12 UTC. removed=405 canonical=7. s3://prod-exports/dedupe_results/3770004321-0319.json
lina_enablement: Zendesk ticket created ZD-78921, tag=cs_dup_email_0319. AE note template uploaded to Confluence.
alex_cs: I'll monitor healthscore trends and reopen if alerts spike. closing thread for now, will post summary in morning.
